final: WITH c AS (SELECT z.city AS city, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM attendance a JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member JOIN zip_code z ON z.zip_code = m.zip GROUP BY z.city), s AS (SELECT city, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share FROM c), g AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - g.avg_share) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg FROM s, g WHERE s.share > g.avg_share
